phrases.english: You're my sunshine, on a rainy day.
phrases.spanish: Eres mi sol, en un día gris.

phrases.english: My world, feels brighter with you.
Lost in your eyes, and I like it.
phrases.spanish: Perdido en tus ojos, y me gusta.

phrases.english: A smile from you, makes my day.
phrases.spanish: Una sonrisa tuya, alegra mi día.

phrases.english: You're the best, part of my life.
phrases.spanish: Eres lo mejor, de mi vida.

phrases.english: My favorite song, is your voice.
phrases.spanish: Mi canción, favorita es tu voz.

phrases.english: Every moment, with you is magic.
You're my home, wherever we are.

phrases.spanish: Mi mundo, gira a tu alrededor.
Mi olor, favorito es el tuyo.
Eres mi paz, en el caos.

phrases.english: Try again, you can do it.

phrases.spanish: No te preocupes, tómate tu tiempo.
Eso está casi bien, intenta otra vez.
Piensa en el contexto, por favor.

phrases.english: Yes, that verb, needs an accent.
Almost there, just a little more.
phrases.spanish: Casi llegas, solo un poco más.

phrases.english: You're getting it, step by step.
phrases.spanish: Lo vas captando, paso a paso.

phrases.english: Remember the gender, of the noun.
That's the right way, to say it.
phrases.spanish: Esa es la forma correcta, de decirlo.

phrases.english: That's a common mistake, fix it.
Keep this up, you're doing great.
phrases.spanish: Sigue así, lo estás haciendo genial.

phrases.english: I hope you can forgive me.
Can you give me a break?
Please don't hold it against me.
phrases.spanish: No me lo tomes a mal.
De verdad, lo siento por eso.

phrases.english: How can I make it right?
What would you do, in my place?
Is there anything else I should know?
How can we avoid this next time?
Are you still upset with me?
How do you feel about it now?
How can I regain your trust?
What do you need from me?
Should we just let it go?

phrases.spanish: Metí la pata, es mi culpa.

phrases.english: Can we clear the air now?
I swallow my pride, for peace.
phrases.spanish: Trago mi orgullo, por la paz.

phrases.english: Let's not dwell on it anymore.
phrases.spanish: No le demos más vueltas a esto.
Mis intenciones eran buenas, de veras.

phrases.english: Can we turn the page, please?
I hope we can move past this.
I throw myself at your feet.
Can we have a clean slate?
I apologize with all my heart.
phrases.spanish: Pido disculpas con todo mi corazón.

phrases.english: I feel a change, inside me.
phrases.spanish: Siento un cambio, en mi interior.
Elijo entender, en vez de enojarme.

phrases.english: This is a process, for me.
I'm letting go, of the pain.
This is for my own good.
phrases.spanish: Esto es, por mi propio bien.

phrases.english: Forgiveness is a gift, to me.
phrases.spanish: El perdón es un regalo, para mí.

phrases.english: Let me show you, my change.
This is exactly what I needed.
phrases.spanish: Esto es justo lo que necesitaba.
Tú haces que las cosas pasen.

phrases.english: What are you looking forward to?
Can you share some good news?
How can I be more positive?
What's your biggest dream right now?
Are you happy with your progress?
What are you grateful for today?
What's one small joy you found?
What's a positive habit you have?
What are you proud of accomplishing?
What's your favorite part of the day?
phrases.spanish: ¿Cuál es tu parte favorita del día?

phrases.english: How can we spread more kindness?
What's a positive change you've made?
phrases.spanish: ¿Cuál es un cambio positivo que hiciste?

phrases.english: What inspires you to keep going?
What's a hopeful thought for tomorrow?
phrases.spanish: ¿Cuál es un pensamiento esperanzador para mañana?

phrases.english: How do you handle challenges positively?
What's a simple pleasure you enjoy?
phrases.spanish: ¿Cuál es un placer simple que disfrutas?

phrases.english: How do you find strength within?
What are you creating in your life?
What makes today special for you?
phrases.spanish: ¿Qué hace este día especial para ti?
Lo estás haciendo genial, de verdad.

phrases.english: You are stronger than you think.
phrases.spanish: Eres más fuerte de lo que crees.

phrases.english: Patience, is a virtue, I practice.
phrases.spanish: La paciencia, es una virtud, que practico.

phrases.english: I am learning, to accept myself.
My heart, feels full, right now.
phrases.spanish: Mi corazón, se siente lleno, ahora.

phrases.english: This moment, is all I have.
phrases.spanish: Este momento, es todo lo que tengo.

phrases.english: I am at peace, with my path.
phrases.spanish: Estoy en paz, con mi camino.
La paz interior, es mi meta.

phrases.english: I am becoming, who I should be.
phrases.spanish: Me estoy convirtiendo, en quien debo ser.
No podría estar más de acuerdo.
En realidad, no estoy de acuerdo.

phrases.english: I don't see it that way.

phrases.spanish: No creo que eso sea verdad.
Eso no está del todo bien.
Vemos las cosas de forma diferente.

phrases.english: That's one way to look at it.
phrases.spanish: Esa es una forma de verlo.

phrases.english: How do you see this, then?
Does that make sense to you?
What if we tried something else?
Is there another way to look?
Do you agree with that idea?
Can you elaborate on that point?
What makes you think that way?
Are we on the same page here?
I need your input on this.
Can you give me your advice?

phrases.spanish: Tengo curiosidad por tu punto de vista.

phrases.english: How do you feel about this?
Let's hear your side of it.

phrases.spanish: Eso es justo lo que pienso, amigo.
Eso es dar en el clavo.
No lo podría haber dicho mejor.
Así es como me siento exactamente.

phrases.english: I'm not so sure about that.
phrases.spanish: No estoy tan seguro de eso.
Esa no es la imagen completa.

phrases.english: Hold on a second, maybe not.

phrases.spanish: No me trago eso, lo siento.

phrases.english: That's not how I see it.
phrases.spanish: No es así como yo lo veo.
Déjame jugar al abogado del diablo.
Podríamos estar pasando algo por alto.

phrases.english: I can't quite get behind that.
I reflect on that a lot.
I feel the truth in your words.
phrases.spanish: Siento la verdad en tus palabras.
Mi voz interior dice que sí.

phrases.english: That feeling is mutual, for sure.
I'm glad we see eye to eye.
I have faith in this direction.
Yes, I see your point, of course.
That makes sense, let's do it.
